title: Add to cart
description: A product action with an Add to cart button and a heart for saving. The button confirms the item was added, and the heart fills when you save it.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The cart button
fragments.note: One attribute drives the tick, the label and what a screen reader hears.

fragments.title: The favourite button
fragments.note: The heart fills and empties with the button's pressed state.

fragments.title: Say it, then close again
fragments.note: A timer from the last press closes it. Presses while it is open only keep it open.

fragments.title: Measure the label's width
fragments.note: The button grows to fit its label, so the script measures it once.

fragments.title: Open and close the button
fragments.note: The button widens to say it was added, then shrinks back.

fragments.title: Colour the heart from the same attribute
fragments.note: Shape and colour read aria-pressed, so they cannot disagree.
